# Xmartlabs Brand Guidelines
 
Use these guidelines whenever creating any artifact, presentation, document, or visual output on behalf of Xmartlabs or its offerings.
 
---
 
## Logo
 
The Xmartlabs logo has several variants. Always include the logo in HTML artifacts. Choose the variant based on background color.
 
### Usage Rules
- Place the horizontal wordmark (icon + "XMARTLABS") in the **top-right** of slides/pages at ~120px wide
- Minimum clear space: equal to the height of the icon mark on all sides
- Never stretch, rotate, recolor, or add effects to the logo
- The icon-only mark can be used as a favicon, watermark, or decorative element

## Typography
 
**Primary font:** `Outfit` (use for all body copy, labels, UI text)
- Weights available: Light, Regular, Medium, SemiBold, Bold
**Secondary / Display font:** `Space Grotesk` (use for headlines, hero text, standout numbers)
- Weights available: Regular, SemiBold, Bold
**Font size hierarchy (reference scale):**
- Hero / stat callout: 40–64px
- H1: 28–33px
- H2: 22–25px
- H3: 18–20px
- Body: 14–16px
- Caption / label: 10–12px
**For HTML/CSS artifacts**, import from Google Fonts:
```html
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
```
 
---
 
## Color Palette
 
### Primary
| Name | Hex | Usage |
|------|-----|-------|
| XL Pink | `#EE1A64` | Primary brand color. CTAs, highlights, key accents |
| XL Dark | `#222831` | Dark backgrounds, headers on dark layouts |
 
### Secondary
| Name | Hex | Usage |
|------|-----|-------|
| Slate | `#4D596B` | Subheadings, secondary text on dark bg |
| Gray | `#85888F` | Body text on light backgrounds |
| Light Gray | `#989898` | Captions, metadata |
| Off White | `#F0F0F0` | Light backgrounds, section dividers |
 
### Accent
| Name | Hex | Usage |
|------|-----|-------|
| Purple | `#5D5FEE` | Accent, tags, secondary CTAs |
| Green | `#407359` | Success states, sustainability/positive metrics |
 
### Pink Scale (use for gradients, tints, hover states)
| Hex | Weight |
|-----|--------|
| `#B5174E` | Dark pink (active/pressed state) |
| `#EE1A64` | **Primary XL Pink** |
| `#F4508A` | Medium pink |
| `#F686AE` | Light pink |
| `#F987AE` | Light pink 2 |
| `#FF88B2` | Pale pink |
| `#FFB1CC` | Very light pink |
| `#FFBDD4` | Blush |
| `#F4B7E3` | Pink tint (lilac-ish) |
 
---
 
## Layout Principles
 
- **Dark layouts**: Use `#222831` background with white (`#FFFFFF`) or `#F0F0F0` text. Accent with `#EE1A64`.
- **Light layouts**: Use `#F0F0F0` or `#FFFFFF` background. Body text in `#4D596B` or `#85888F`. Headlines in `#222831`.
- **Pink accent layouts**: `#EE1A64` backgrounds work for hero sections or covers. Use white text only.
- Corner decorations: The template uses black geometric corner elements as decorative accents (rotated squares). Optional but on-brand.
---
 
## Pills / Tags / Badges
- Lilac pill: light purple tint bg, dark text — best on dark backgrounds
- Light pink pill: pink tint bg — best on light backgrounds  
- Dark pink pill: `#EE1A64` or `#B5174E` bg, white text — best on pink backgrounds
- White pill: white bg, dark text — best on pink backgrounds
- Always use border-radius: 999px for pill shape
---
 
## Voice & Tone (for copy in artifacts)
- Confident but not arrogant
- Technical precision without jargon overload
- Lead with outcomes and proof points, not features
- Use active voice
- Numbers and metrics always prominent — they're the credibility anchors
---
 
## Artifact-Specific Notes
 
### One-pagers & PDFs
- Use dark header section (`#222831`) with XL Pink accents
- Main content on white/off-white background
- Key stats or callouts in large Space Grotesk bold with `#EE1A64` color
- Footer: dark bar with white text
### Pitch decks / Presentations (HTML slides)
 
**Slide format and export:**
- Use fixed dimensions: `1280px x 720px` (16:9 landscape) per slide
- Each section = 1 slide. Content must fit within the slide, no overflow
- Use `page-break-after: always` and `page-break-inside: avoid` for clean PDF export
- Set `@page { size: 1280px 720px; margin: 0; }` for correct print sizing
- Users export via Chrome Print > Save as PDF with "Background graphics" enabled
- Use `-webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact;` on slides
**Slide structure:**
- Each `.slide` is `position: relative` with `overflow: hidden`
- `.slide-content` has padding `56px 72px 64px` and `height: calc(720px - 40px)` to leave room for footer
- Footer is `position: absolute; bottom: 0` with `height: 40px`
**Footer (consistent on every slide):**
- Left: Xmartlabs logo SVG (small, ~80px wide). IMPORTANT: always use the COMPLETE logo SVG from the Logo section above, including ALL letter paths (X, M, A, R, T, L, A, B, S) plus the icon. Never truncate paths
- Right: document title + "Confidential"
- Dark footer (`slide-footer dark`): dark bg, white text, white+pink logo
- Light footer: white bg, gray text, dark+pink logo
- Font size: 10px
**Slide themes (alternate for visual rhythm):**
- Dark slides (`#222831` bg): for company overview, case studies, closing
- Light slides (`#FFFFFF` bg): for content-heavy sections
- Off-white slides (`#F0F0F0` bg): for talent/tech sections
- Pink slides (`#EE1A64` bg): use sparingly, only for section dividers. Not for content-heavy slides as it can feel overwhelming
**Slide templates:**
- **Cover**: dark bg, logo top-left, large Space Grotesk headline, subtitle in gray, optional corner decoration
- **Content**: section number label (uppercase, pink, 11px), h2 headline, body text + bullet lists. Use two-column layout when content allows
- **Stats**: row of large stat callouts (Space Grotesk 42px bold in pink) with small labels below
- **Cards**: grid of 2x2 cards with tag pill, h4 title, compact bullet list. Good for case studies
- **Divider**: centered headline on pink bg, used to introduce a new major section
- **Closing**: split layout, left side with contact info, right side with faded icon watermark
**Typography sizes for slides:**
- Body text / paragraphs: 16px
- Bullet list items: 15px
- Stat callout values: 42px (Space Grotesk bold)
- Card list items: 13px
- Why-card body text: 14px
- Section number labels: 11px
- Footer: 10px
**Charts/data:** use the pink scale for bar fills, `#5D5FEE` for contrast series
 
### React components / web artifacts
- Import Outfit + Space Grotesk from Google Fonts
- Define CSS variables at :root for all brand colors
- Dark mode default for dashboards; light mode for documents
---
 
## CSS Variables Boilerplate
```css
:root {
  --xl-pink: #EE1A64;
  --xl-pink-dark: #B5174E;
  --xl-pink-light: #F4508A;
  --xl-pink-pale: #FFB1CC;
  --xl-dark: #222831;
  --xl-slate: #4D596B;
  --xl-gray: #85888F;
  --xl-light: #F0F0F0;
  --xl-purple: #5D5FEE;
  --xl-green: #407359;
  --font-primary: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  --font-display: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
}
```
